summary: 26 features and 17 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • planning-directions: render localized prompt fragments (2758dd0)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: size the composer to its panel width (c3d8d10)
  • command: open sessions directly from command rows and tiles (a03aeff)
  • command: rank sessions and include archived tiles (34fdbaf)
  • layout: stage view previews in a side drawer (d060b63)
  • command: let focused tiles choose their message mode (ce146b5)
  • session: allow closing the detail drawer from desktop (892563f)
  • kanban: show repository details in merged operations (53d01f9)
  • matrix: add project actions and richer session rows (4308267)
  • command: show live conversations in monitor tiles (5998aca)
  • matrix: animate cell panels and show status composition (e017f0a)
  • command: animate tile changes and place new sessions (382673b)
  • kanban: align the multi-project operations panel (f16ff17)
  • conversation: show compact runtime token totals (ae2a442)
  • ui: add customized trace disclosure component (5f55eaf)
  • statusbar: show token milestones in a phone bottom strip (414f714)
  • layout: animate previews for each workspace layout option (55c39ae)
  • proposal: compact repository controls on phone screens (e5b9bce)
  • session: add quick and stage actions across session surfaces (3efdd93)
  • kanban: expand multi-project operations and session views (9ea061e)
  • conversation: add diagram and steering improvements (90ac464)
  • kanban: add matrix and command session views (2ffee27)
  • ui: add a brief visual bloom to pressed buttons (336900e)
  • layout: add QR and voice mute controls to the header (5d4f7b7)
  • achievement: show unlock notices along the phone edge (ba2ef1b)
  • conversation: animate runtime state and token changes (884686c)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: close the drawer after deleting its session (3dcf1bf)
  • matrix: give project identities room and hide idle attention (930bfcf)
  • proposal: open waiting sessions on the conversation tab (1a14f11)
  • proposal: cap desktop Mermaid previews to the pane (e44d8c3)
  • mermaid: contain Escape in the enlarged viewer (ce08964)
  • reports: keep daily report navigation in view on phones (e5c3429)
  • voice: use current device and connection state (925a270)
  • hero: align drafts with API defaults (b131ed0)
  • notifications: align listener with current settings (728fefa)
  • project-list: add labeled status badge actions (1b5e3a6)
  • session: scope file errors and deletion refreshes (ecf1ad1)
  • hagitask: map session states and source diagnostics (22cd160)
  • api: align callers with generated contracts (b0b0605)
  • reports: evaluate automatic reports once per page load (9b2871b)
  • session: use compact actions in the phone create group (f0c1f17)
  • session: refresh profile pickers from the shared hero roster (d058d29)
  • checklist: show required content only in wide drawer rails (57319ea)
